ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a rectangular prism container. The top face is square-looking with two top edge directions labeled 10 inches and 10 inches, and a vertical edge is labeled 12 inches. Reasoning: The text says it is a six-sided aluminum container, so use the full surface area of a rectangular prism with dimensions 10, 10, and 12. Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(10*10 + 10*12 + 10*12) = 2(100 + 120 + 120) = 680 square inches. Aluminum costs $0.05 per square inch, so cost = 680 * 0.05 = 34 dollars.
